value.rationale: Optimizing the slowest decay at a fixed independent-edge noise-strength budget is a motivated physical design problem. The classification establishes not only a sharp optimal relaxation coefficient but also all-size design rigidity and an exceptional strictly-positive nonuniform optimal family at four sites. The N=4 exception gives a mathematically substantive range of equivalent designs not obtained by restating a known uniform symmetric spectrum.
